aiDataSharing.label: AI data sharing
aiDataSharing.description: AI features send what you enter to Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI for processing. Speech is turned into text on your device or by Apple or Google speech recognition. Audio files aren't sent to Aido's servers.
aiDataSharing.descriptionGoogleOnly: AI features send what you enter to Google Gemini for processing.
aiDataSharing.withdrawDescription: You won't be able to use AI for organizing to-dos, summaries, reports, or suggestions. Existing to-dos stay.
aiDataSharing.declinedStatus: Turned off. Turn it on to use AI features again.
aiDataSharing.undecidedStatus: Not chosen yet. We'll ask the first time you use an AI feature.

voiceStorage.description: Audio files aren't sent to Aido's servers. Voice notes and their audio are deleted automatically after 30 days.
voiceStorage.removeDescription: The text and summary stay. Only the audio is deleted, so you can't play it back. This can't be undone.
